The weighted hospital bedflow calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core risk-assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the logic is reusable, the 7-minute runtime suggests potential overhead in the adhoc hermes environment that should be monitored. Future iterations should re-check edge case handling for zero-weight inputs to ensure the weighted calculation remains robust.
